name: audio-off
summary: Skip the headphone DAC (NAU8401) power-up at start and wake: saves ~350 ms of anti-pop waits; the 3.5 mm output stays off

edits.asm: b.jal 0x241505 -> b.j 0x20c5cc (sub_20C579: skip NAU8401 reset/power-up writes and the 1+1+250+100 ms waits, keep the 0x44B/0x44D bit 7 pin writes)

notes: I2C 0x34 is the NAU8401 DAC (datasheet: fixed device address 0011010). sub_20C579 runs the datasheet's anti-pop power-up (R1 = 0x10F, ~250 ms, configuration table at 0x34220B, 100 ms) on every start and wake from standby. No other code writes the DAC except the standby-entry sequence sub_20C537. With the patch the DAC keeps its power-on reset state (all outputs disabled), so the headphone output is silent.
